id.instruksi: Dua tahap siklus air tertukar tempat. Tukar keduanya: penguapan, pengembunan, hujan, lalu air mengalir kembali.
id.danau-uap: air danau menguap menjadi uap air
id.danau-awan: uap mendingin di atas gunung dan mengembun jadi awan
id.danau-alir: air mengalir lewat parit kembali ke danau
id.sawah-uap: air sawah menguap di siang terik
id.sawah-awan: uap naik, mendingin, dan mengembun jadi awan
id.sawah-alir: air mengalir lewat saluran irigasi ke sungai
id.hutan-daun: daun-daun melepaskan uap air ke udara
id.hutan-dingin: uap naik dan mendingin di udara atas
id.hutan-awan: uap mengembun jadi awan tebal di atas hutan
id.hutan-alir: air meresap ke tanah dan mengalir ke sungai
id.waduk-uap: air waduk menguap sedikit demi sedikit
id.waduk-alir: sungai membawa air hujan mengisi waduk lagi
id.kolam-awan: uap mengembun jadi awan di langit
id.kolam-alir: air hujan dari atap mengalir mengisi kolam lagi
id.lapangan-awan: uap mendingin dan mengembun jadi awan
id.lapangan-alir: air mengalir ke selokan dan sungai
id.pulau-awan: angin membawa uap yang mengembun jadi awan
id.pulau-hujan: hujan tawar turun di bukit pulau
id.pulau-alir: sungai kecil membawa air kembali ke laut
id.mangkuk-air: mangkuk berisi air ditutup plastik dan dijemur
id.mangkuk-embun: uap mengembun jadi titik air di plastik
id.mangkuk-tetes: titik air menetes kembali ke mangkuk seperti hujan
id.gunung-uap: air dari laut dan sungai menguap
id.gunung-awan: uap mengembun jadi awan di puncak gunung
id.gunung-hujan: hujan turun dan meresap ke tanah gunung
id.gunung-mata: air tanah keluar sebagai mata air
id.gunung-alir: air mata air mengalir menjadi sungai
id.kubangan-uap: air kubangan menguap di siang hari
id.kubangan-alir: air hujan mengalir mengisi kubangan lagi

en.instruksi: Two stages of the water cycle have swapped. Swap them back: evaporation, condensation, rain, then water flowing back.
en.danau-uap: lake water evaporates into water vapour
en.danau-awan: the vapour cools above the mountain and condenses into clouds
en.danau-hujan: rain falls on the mountain slopes
en.danau-alir: the water flows down streams back to the lake
en.sawah-uap: water in the rice field evaporates in the hot sun
en.sawah-awan: the vapour rises, cools and condenses into clouds
en.sawah-gelap: the clouds grow thick and dark
en.sawah-hujan: rain falls on the rice field
en.sawah-alir: water flows through the ditches to the river
en.hutan-daun: the leaves give off water vapour
en.hutan-dingin: the vapour rises and cools high up
en.hutan-awan: the vapour condenses into thick clouds over the forest
en.hutan-hujan: heavy rain falls on the forest
en.hutan-alir: the water soaks into the ground and flows to a river
en.s-waduk: A reservoir in the dry season
en.waduk-awan: the water vapour condenses into clouds
en.waduk-hujan: the rainy season comes and rain falls
en.waduk-alir: rivers carry the rainwater to fill the reservoir again
en.s-kolam: A fish pond in the yard
en.kolam-panas: a hot afternoon shines on the pond
en.kolam-uap: the pond water evaporates and the level drops
en.kolam-awan: the vapour condenses into clouds in the sky
en.kolam-alir: rainwater from the roof flows back into the pond
en.lapangan-basah: the field is wet and the Sun shines hot
en.lapangan-uap: the water on the field evaporates
en.lapangan-awan: the vapour cools and condenses into clouds
en.lapangan-hujan: in the afternoon rain falls again
en.lapangan-alir: the water runs into the drains and the river
en.pulau-uap: seawater evaporates and the salt stays behind
en.pulau-awan: the wind carries the vapour, which condenses into clouds
en.pulau-hujan: fresh rain falls on the island's hills
en.pulau-alir: small rivers carry the water back to the sea
en.s-mangkuk: A water cycle model on a window
en.mangkuk-air: a bowl of water is covered with plastic and put in the sun
en.mangkuk-uap: the water in the bowl evaporates
en.mangkuk-embun: the vapour condenses into drops on the plastic
en.mangkuk-tetes: the drops fall back into the bowl like rain
en.gunung-uap: water from seas and rivers evaporates
en.gunung-awan: the vapour condenses into clouds at the summit
en.gunung-hujan: rain falls and soaks into the mountain soil
en.gunung-mata: the groundwater comes out as a spring
en.gunung-alir: the spring water flows on as a river
en.kubangan-uap: water in the mud pool evaporates in the day
en.kubangan-awan: the water vapour condenses into clouds
en.kubangan-alir: rainwater runs back to fill the mud pool
